post:

As comic fans know, this special suit is actually a living alien symbiote that eventually becomes Venom!

headline: Marvel Comics May Finally Undo One More Day
post:
Spider-Man fans might finally get some long-awaited relief. According to Screen Rant, Marvel Comics is seemingly reversing one of the most controversial stories in the hero's history. Back in 2007's "One More Day", Peter Parker and Mary Jane Watson made a dark bargain with Mephisto to save Aunt May, which erased their entire marriage from existence.

Now, a massive shift in the underworld has changed everything. Following the events of the "Avengers: Armageddon" crossover, Doctor Doom overthrew Mephisto and declared all demonic contracts null and void. 

In the brand-new "Avengers #1" series from Chip Zdarsky and Marco Checchetto, those old agreements are reportedly coming undone across the globe. Peter's infamous deal appears to be among them, setting up a massive status quo shift for our favorite wall-crawler. 

Are you ready to see Peter and MJ's history restored? 🕷️

#SpiderMan #MarvelComics #Avengers
original_title: Marvel Is Reversing A 19-Year-Old Spider-Man Mistake, But There's A Dark Catch

post:

headline: Ten essential Superman stories every DC fan needs
post:
Superman isn’t just DC’s premier superhero, but rather the ultimate archetype of a shining symbol of hope and boundless power. Casual audiences often misunderstand him as an uninteresting boy scout, but his true appeal lies in his profound humanity and godlike abilities chosen to serve those in need. According to Screen Rant, navigating decades of comic history can be daunting, which is why a new feature highlights ten of the greatest Superman stories to read. From Kurt Busiek and Stuart Immonen's Secret Identity exploring a teenager gaining the hero's powers in our world, to Mark Waid and Francis Yu's Birthright delivering a definitive modern origin, these tales test the Man of Steel in bold ways. Other highlights include Kingdom Come, The Death of Superman, Red Son, and All-Star Superman, which all capture his enduring legacy. Which of these iconic graphic novels is your absolute favorite? 

#Superman #DCComics #ManOfSteel
original_title: 10 Greatest Superman Stories That Every DC Fan Should Read

headline: DC Studios recruits writer for new Constantine movie
post:
According to Deadline, DC Studios has recruited filmmaker Francis Galluppi to write a new movie starring John Constantine for James Gunn's DC Universe.

Keanu Reeves has previously pushed for a sequel to his 2005 Constantine film, but it remains unclear if that project will continue following this new development.

Further updates will follow as more information becomes available.
